text:
anya: Heads-up — we got an intake for a new open checkpoint (sable-7b-ish). Request from a mid-market customer who needs better latency than current 7B quantized. Can we triage and decide bring-up priority?

sasha: +1. do we have eval artifacts?

anya: They attached a small eval set (conversational support + factual QA). I pushed baseline runs to S3: s3://redwood-evals/sable-intake/179124. Need perf numbers, regression risk, and suggested prompt templates for integration.

mike: I can run quant experiments today. plan: PTQ->GPTQ->AWQ (q8_0, q4_0, q4_k) and measure latency & perplexity. which dev env should I use?

linh: use the perf rig: grpc-node-08 (A10G) for latency, and local emu (cpu) for quick correctness. infra-bot: created job perf-179124 on grpc-node-08.

infra-bot: job perf-179124 queued -> running. logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/perf-179124

anya: quick prioritization rubric proposal (suggest we vote):
- customer_impact: 40% (revenue + blocker)
- perf_gain: 25% (latency / cost delta)
- risk_regression: 20% (eval drop probability)
- engineering_cost: 15% (effort to onboard)
Reply with +1 to accept or suggest changes.

sasha: +1 to weights. also add privacy flag — customer needs VPC-ready.

mike: running first quant pass. will post numbers.

evals-bot: automated evals finished. baseline (fp16) -> micro-qa acc: 78.2, conv-coher: 0.86. artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/sable-intake/179124/baseline.jsonl

anya: good. once mike posts quant numbers we can decide whether to promote to staging for full rollout tests. also need chat template + tool calling example for their support use-case.

linh: propose a minimal chat template for customers integrating via the Redwood API. keep explicit structured output so downstream agents can parse. Example below (use as copy-paste):

```
System: You are a helpful assistant that answers user support questions. Always return JSON matching the schema in the "expected_output" tool call unless you call a live tool.
User: {{user_message}}
Assistant: (if needed, call the tool `kb_search` to fetch docs)

Tool call format:
{
  "tool": "kb_search",
  "query": "<user question>",
  "top_k": 3
}

If you call `kb_search`, return only after summarizing results into the structured output. Otherwise return structured output directly.
```

linh: structured output schema (enforceable via schema-checker):

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "answer": {"type": "string"},
    "confidence": {"type": "number"},
    "sources": {"type": "array", "items": {"type":"string"}},
    "actions": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "type": {"type":"string"},
          "payload": {"type":"string"}
        },
        "required": ["type"]
      }
    }
  },
  "required": ["answer", "confidence"]
}
```

anya: Love that. Also include example Redwood API call for structured output + tool calling (devs will copy).

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "sable-7b-q4_k",
    "input": ["System: You are a helpful assistant...","User: How do I reset my API key?"],
    "tools": ["kb_search"],
    "schema": {"type":"json_schema", "ref":"/expected_output"},
    "stream": false
  }' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/generate
```

mike: quant results first pass (quick):
- q8_0: micro-qa acc 77.9, p50 token latency 42ms (on node)
- q4_0: micro-qa acc 76.3, p50 28ms
- q4_k (GPTQ-like): micro-qa acc 76.9, p50 26ms
Notes: small drop vs fp16 (~1.3 pts) but big latency/cost win. saving ~2.8x cost compared to fp16 in our infra.

anya: sounds promising. can you run a misinfo test + hallucination probe from the eval set? put results in a short report.

mike: will do. targeting the hallucination probe next.

linh: checklist for onboarding to staging (short):
- [ ] Intake form complete (contact, use-case, data sensitivity)
- [ ] Eval artifacts uploaded (baseline + testsets)
- [ ] Quant configs tried + perf numbers (q8_0, q4 variants)
- [ ] Schema + sample chat template checked in docs repo (PR)
- [ ] Staging deploy + smoke tests (latency p50/p95, mem)
- [ ] Canary traffic + rollback plan
- [ ] Security review (VPC, KMS)
- [ ] Cost estimate and recommended default profile

anya: add automated regression alerts (evals) on the PR: if micro-qa drops >2 pts, block promoton.

sasha: quick question on prompt formatting: do we prefer single-turn prompts with explicit tool call markers or chat-based with system messages?

linh: prefer chat-based for multi-step flows; system message defines tool interface and output schema. single-turn is okay for simple calls. include both templates in docs.

mike: infra-bot: perf job finished. results summary attached to S3 (perf + logs). starting hallucination probe.

infra-bot: perf-179124 -> completed. artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/sable-intake/179124/perf_summary.json

evals-bot: hallucination probe done. false-assertion rate: 4.7% (fp16 baseline 4.2%). full CSV: s3://redwood-evals/sable-intake/179124/hallucinations.csv

anya: ok next steps:
- mike: finalize quant & hallucination report by EOD
- linh: draft chat+tool docs PR (include both templates + schema)
- sasha: reach out to customer for VPC details and expected traffic
- infra-bot: create staging deploy job when we mark "promote_to_staging"

sasha: noted. pinging customer now.

anya: thanks team — this thread will be the canonical triage. I'll convert the checklist to a tracker issue after we have the final numbers.

mike: will update. :rocket:

linh: adding a tiny tip — when writing the schema, keep confidence numeric 0-1; it's easier to threshold in downstream systems.

anya: agreed. end of thread.
